jock landale.name: Jock Landale
jock landale.comment: Landale (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Indiana.

jalen johnson.name: Jalen Johnson
jalen johnson.comment: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game versus Indiana.

mouhamed gueye.name: Mouhamed Gueye
mouhamed gueye.comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

henri veesaar.name: Henri Veesaar
henri veesaar.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

paul george.name: Paul George
paul george.comment: George will be rested Monday against Houston.

devin carter.name: Devin Carter
devin carter.comment: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

egor demin.name: Egor Demin
egor demin.comment: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

tyler bilodeau.name: Tyler Bilodeau
tyler bilodeau.comment: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.

grant williams.name: Grant Williams
grant williams.comment: Williams (hamstring) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Pistons.

kon knueppel.name: Kon Knueppel
kon knueppel.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) is listed as out for Monday's game versus the Pistons.

nic claxton.name: Nic Claxton
nic claxton.comment: Claxton (hamstring) is out for Monday's game against the 76ers.

peyton watson.name: Peyton Watson
peyton watson.comment: Watson (hamstring) is out for Monday's game against the Thunder, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

jaylon tyson.name: Jaylon Tyson
jaylon tyson.comment: Tyson (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Oklahoma City.

kyrie irving.name: Kyrie Irving
kyrie irving.comment: Irving (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Kings.

max christie.name: Max Christie
max christie.comment: Christie has been ruled out for the rest of Monday's game against the Kings due to a right hip injury, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports. He'll end the night with no points (0-5 FG, 0-5 3Pt), two rebounds and one steal in eight minutes.

santi aldama.name: Santi Aldama
santi aldama.comment: Aldama (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's matchup with Sacramento.

tarik biberovic.name: Tarik Biberovic
tarik biberovic.comment: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.

dereck lively.name: Dereck Lively II
dereck lively.comment: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.

sergio de larrea.name: Sergio de Larrea
sergio de larrea.comment: Head coach Dusty May said Friday that de Larrea (knee) will be re-evaluated next week, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reports.

spencer jones.name: Spencer Jones
spencer jones.comment: Jones (hamstring) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Trail Blazers.

julian strawther.name: Julian Strawther
julian strawther.comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

isaiah joe.name: Isaiah Joe
isaiah joe.comment: Joe (hip) is out for Monday against the Hornets.

jalen duren.name: Jalen Duren
jalen duren.comment: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

brandon williams.name: Brandon Williams
brandon williams.comment: Williams (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Suns.

gui santos.name: Gui Santos
gui santos.comment: Santos did not play in the second half of Sunday's 124-112 win over the Clippers due to a knee injury and will not play against the Suns on Monday, Danny Emerman of SFStandard.com reports.

al horford.name: Al Horford
al horford.comment: Horford will be rested Monday against the Suns.

kristaps porzingis.name: Kristaps Porzingis
kristaps porzingis.comment: The Warriors are exploring potential trades involving Porzingis (personal), who remains away from the team indefinitely while dealing with ongoing health concerns, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

moses moody.name: Moses Moody
moses moody.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

jimmy butler.name: Jimmy Butler III
jimmy butler.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

clint capela.name: Clint Capela
clint capela.comment: Capela (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.

steven adams.name: Steven Adams
steven adams.comment: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

pascal siakam.name: Pascal Siakam
pascal siakam.comment: Siakam will be rested against the Hawks on Monday.

aaron nesmith.name: Aaron Nesmith
aaron nesmith.comment: Nesmith (rest) is sitting out Monday against Atlanta.

andrew nembhard.name: Andrew Nembhard
andrew nembhard.comment: Nembhard (cervical strain) is out for Monday's game against Atlanta.

kelly oubre.name: Kelly Oubre Jr.
kelly oubre.comment: Oubre (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hawks.

larry nance.name: Larry Nance Jr.
larry nance.comment: Nance (illness) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hawks.

obi toppin.name: Obi Toppin
obi toppin.comment: Toppin (back) will dress for Monday's game against  Hawks but will only play in an emergency, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

tj mcconnell.name: T.J. McConnell
tj mcconnell.comment: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Monday's game against the Hawks and remains week-to-week.

ivica zubac.name: Ivica Zubac
ivica zubac.comment: Zubac (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hawks.

johnny furphy.name: Johnny Furphy
johnny furphy.comment: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

ben sheppard.name: Ben Sheppard
ben sheppard.comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

tyrese haliburton.name: Tyrese Haliburton
tyrese haliburton.comment: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

derrick jones.name: Derrick Jones Jr.
derrick jones.comment: Jones (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Raptors.

rui hachimura.name: Rui Hachimura
rui hachimura.comment: Hachimura (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Raptors.

yanic konan niederhauser.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
yanic konan niederhauser.comment: The Clippers recalled Niederhauser (foot) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.

brandon ingram.name: Brandon Ingram
brandon ingram.comment: The Clippers recalled Ingram (Achilles) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.

bradley beal.name: Bradley Beal
bradley beal.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

jordan miller.name: Jordan Miller
jordan miller.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

adou thiero.name: Adou Thiero
adou thiero.comment: Head coach JJ Redick said Monday that Thiero (knee) has participated in live action, and the hope is that he'll be available by the end of the week, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.

quinten post.name: Quinten Post
quinten post.comment: Post (ankle) has been downgraded to out for Monday's game against the Pelicans.

scotty pippen.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
scotty pippen.comment: Pippen (back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pelicans.

terrence shannon.name: Terrence Shannon Jr.
terrence shannon.comment: Shannon (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bucks, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

anthony edwards.name: Anthony Edwards
anthony edwards.comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

donte divincenzo.name: Donte DiVincenzo
donte divincenzo.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

dejounte murray.name: Dejounte Murray
dejounte murray.comment: Murray (personal) is out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies.

jordan poole.name: Jordan Poole
jordan poole.comment: Poole (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies.

yves missi.name: Yves Missi
yves missi.comment: Missi (knee) won't play in Saturday's game against Atlanta.

thomas sorber.name: Thomas Sorber
thomas sorber.comment: Oklahoma City exercised the third-year team option on Sorber (knee) on Sunday, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

cason wallace.name: Cason Wallace
cason wallace.comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

chet holmgren.name: Chet Holmgren
chet holmgren.comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

jalen williams.name: Jalen Williams
jalen williams.comment: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

alex caruso.name: Alex Caruso
alex caruso.comment: Caruso (ankle) is expected to miss time due to an ankle sprain, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

nikola topic.name: Nikola Topic
nikola topic.comment: Topic (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game in Dallas.

anthony black.name: Anthony Black
anthony black.comment: Black will be rested Monday against the Wizards.

jonathan isaac.name: Jonathan Isaac
jonathan isaac.comment: Orlando recalled Isaac (knee) from the G League's Osceola Magic on Sunday.

jalen suggs.name: Jalen Suggs
jalen suggs.comment: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

paolo banchero.name: Paolo Banchero
paolo banchero.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

noah penda.name: Noah Penda
noah penda.comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

izaiyah nelson.name: Izaiyah Nelson
izaiyah nelson.comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

dominick barlow.name: Dominick Barlow
dominick barlow.comment: Barlow (back) has been on the court "a little bit" and will be re-evaluated Tuesday, Austin Krell of OnPattison.com reports.

ariel hukporti.name: Ariel Hukporti
ariel hukporti.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

jordan goodwin.name: Jordan Goodwin
jordan goodwin.comment: Goodwin won't return to Monday's game against the Warriors due to a left calf injury, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports. He recorded four points (2-3 FG, 0-1 3Pt), two rebounds, two assists and one steal in 10 minutes before exiting.

mark williams.name: Mark Williams
mark williams.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

ja morant.name: Ja Morant
ja morant.comment: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.

shaedon sharpe.name: Shaedon Sharpe
shaedon sharpe.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

dylan cardwell.name: Dylan Cardwell
dylan cardwell.comment: Cardwell (calf) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Mavericks.

maxime raynaud.name: Maxime Raynaud
maxime raynaud.comment: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

keegan murray.name: Keegan Murray
keegan murray.comment: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

ben simmons.name: Ben Simmons
ben simmons.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

tobias harris.name: Tobias Harris
tobias harris.comment: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.

jayden quaintance.name: Jayden Quaintance
jayden quaintance.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

jakob poeltl.name: Jakob Poeltl
jakob poeltl.comment: Poeltl (shoulder) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Clippers, Zulfi Sheikh reports.

nate bittle.name: Nate Bittle
nate bittle.comment: Bittle (foot) is out for Monday's game against the Clippers and remains without a timetable to return.

kawhi leonard.name: Kawhi Leonard
kawhi leonard.comment: Leonard (knee) is expected to be sidelined for at least three to four weeks, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

jaren jackson.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
jaren jackson.comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

trey alexander.name: Trey Alexander
trey alexander.comment: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

jusuf nurkic.name: Jusuf Nurkic
jusuf nurkic.comment: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

alex sarr.name: Alex Sarr
alex sarr.comment: Sarr (knee) is out for Monday's game against Orlando.

anthony gill.name: Anthony Gill
anthony gill.comment: Gill (back) is out for Monday's game against the Magic.

reece beekman.name: Reece Beekman
reece beekman.comment: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

tristan vukcevic.name: Tristan Vukcevic
tristan vukcevic.comment: Vukcevic (hip) is listed as out for Monday's game against Orlando.

justin champagnie.name: Justin Champagnie
justin champagnie.comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

jamir watkins.name: Jamir Watkins
jamir watkins.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
